complaints.theme: Rude, dismissive, or visibly checked-out front-counter staff
quotes: One of your ladies up front is by far the rudest person I have ever had to work with. Ever.
I wish I could give an accurate review of the food, but the older lady at the counter was so rude and disrespectful that I left before I ordered.
I was treated with such disrespect from the cashier that I ended up walking out of the restaurant without ordering.
Employee taking our order clearly hung over or actively on something, slurring words. Our sandwiches were not made properly, very lazy.

complaints.theme: Portion size / protein shrinkage on named signature sandwiches
quotes: Got the large motherload and there was hardly any meat on it. What happened to this place? Used to be great. This is like 16$ sandwich with no protein.
BAIT AND SWITCH!!! The picture on the wall looks awesome but the sandwich I got was unrecognizable. I ate 1/2 of it and it is basically a half sandwich.
My main gripe is the sorry amount of veggies on my veggie sandwich. I was hoping for a nice amount of hummus and avocado. I couldn't see the avocado.

complaints.theme: Slow, unpredictable wait times with orders served out of sequence
quotes: Sometimes you wait 5 minutes, sometimes 25 minutes. Sometimes they prepare food in the order it came in, sometimes you watch the seven people who came after you leave first.
Took 40 minutes for my sandwich and several people who ordered their food 10 minutes after me got their food before me.
It took 40 minutes to get my food. There was maybe 4 other people in there. They got my order wrong 3 times before I even got food.

complaints.theme: Prices feel high relative to portion ("spendy")
quotes: Little on the spendy side, but overall matches up with other sandwich shops.
A bit expensive but food and gluten free options are good.
Great food and easy place to make a stop at, however every single time i go its hard to swallow the bill.

complaints.theme: Order accuracy errors and unannounced recipe/menu changes
quotes: Got home with my order... it's not Caesar dressing... their Caesar recipe/supplier may have changed... she basically called me a liar.
Great food, wish they would have remembered the grilled onions I asked for.
Every time we order something is missing from our order.

complaints.theme: Handwritten/ad-hoc signage and unexplained early closures
quotes: Employees had a hand written sign closing at 2:30. We beat that time.
Her greeting was that there would be a 30-40 minute delay... she could have said something to us such as 'i will still take your order'.
Apparently they were 'booked solid' and 'not taking any orders for 30 to 45 minutes.'

complaints.theme: Unmet requests for specific menu items no longer offered or missing
quotes: Wish they still had the veggie meat option.
I just wish they had tuna sandwiches like at subway :)
i wish they took apple pay

complaints.theme: Foreign objects / food-safety incidents met with no acknowledgment
quotes: As i was filling my cup a chunk of mold came. The 'manager' on duty argued with me stating it was not mold but a fruit chunk.
My tomato basil soup had a hair in it... just after hearing another customer report a hair in her food.
There was barely any avocado, the avocado was brown, egg had no seasoning... they did not even say sorry or offer a refund.
